summary.content:
Today's selection covers 56 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 33 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: A.I. Is on Its Way to Upending Cybersecurity
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Microsoft links Medusa ransomware affiliate to zero-day attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, The Verge, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 37 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.description: With new systems from companies like Anthropic and OpenAI, hackers can attack with greater speed. The defense is more A.I.

top.description: In recognition of 21 generative AI risks, the standards groups recommends that companies take separate but linked approaches to defending GenAI and agentic AI systems.
